Subject: Commit uplift: billing recipient & PO for expanded capacity

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion OrbitApps is moving forward with the 40% commit uplift (production capacity + burst). Two quick asks to get the renewal/upsell into billing: 

1) Can you confirm the billing recipient for invoices going forward? On the call you mentioned invoices should go to the parent company (OrbitApps Group Ltd) rather than OrbitApps Ireland. If that's correct we need the formal payor name, billing address, and VAT id.

2) Please upload the purchase order referencing deal DEAL-6732 (PO number preferred) and indicate the net terms you require (Net 30/45/60).

3) We'll prepare a one-page commit addendum (DocuSign) to attach to the renewal. Once you confirm the payor I'll route to our legal & finance for sign-off. If OrbitApps needs any custom invoicing fields (cost center, project code) please list them.

I attached a checklist for your finance team to this thread.

Thanks — aiming to have invoices routable by the next billing cycle.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
